use_case.problem: Teachers and tutors need timely support for probing questions, misconception checks, and hint ladders without letting AI give answers or own records.
intended_tasks: draft hint ladders for human selection

data_map.logs: aggregate use counts, owner-reviewed move samples, workload minutes, and incident class counts only during sandbox
data_map.retention: delete prompt/output working notes after local review; keep only aggregate readout and owner decision
data_map.subprocessors_or_storage: approved sandbox or local test environment with no student profile storage
data_map.export_or_continuity_route: ordinary teacher/tutor practice continues without AI; non-AI hints and teacher explanation remain available

authority.rollback_route: disable coach prompts and continue with teacher/tutor-led practice

memory.inspection_or_correction_route: no durable learner profile; owner can inspect local aggregate readout and move samples
memory.protected_local_record_route: none; protected support stays outside the coach

evidence_claims.claim: Tutor-facing move suggestions may improve low-stakes practice transfer when humans keep control.
evidence_claims.evidence_source: external Tutor CoPilot evidence and local theory of change; no local outcome yet; rev0336 keeps that scratch-local route but masks exact small-cell counts/rates in any local result receipt before it can travel
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: does not prove durable learning, scale readiness, or effectiveness for autonomous student-facing tutoring
evidence_claims.renewal_or_repilot_trigger: after one micro-pilot or any move-type change

evidence_claims.claim: Move suggestions may reduce preparation or in-session decision burden after review time is counted.
evidence_claims.evidence_source: local workload plan before micro-pilot; no local workload result yet; readiness scoring checks aggregate workload rows, dry-run scoring stays synthetic-only, owner-review/result receipts preserve the human boundary, and rev0336 field handoff, run sheet, chronology check, and suppressed result receipt reduce packet-to-cycle/result ambiguity without upgrading claims
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: does not prove net time savings or general staff-capacity improvement
early_expiry_triggers: owner cannot use suggestions during authentic practice

construct_and_proof.construct_or_support_duty: practice reasoning, misconception correction, and independent explanation
construct_and_proof.required_unaided_segment: baseline and transfer/explanation check run without AI during proof capture
construct_and_proof.disclosure_rule: teachers/tutors disclose that AI may help them select practice prompts; learners are not asked to use the AI in the micro-pilot
construct_and_proof.proof_bundle: aggregate baseline, coach-use, and transfer/explanation rows plus owner move-quality sample count
construct_and_proof.authentication_or_checkpoint_route: teacher/tutor reviews independent explanation or transfer item
construct_and_proof.contest_or_reconsideration_route: learner can use ordinary teacher/tutor support and non-AI practice path

accessibility_and_protected_support.no_penalty_fallback: ordinary non-AI practice and teacher/tutor support without penalty
accessibility_and_protected_support.bias_or_subgroup_check: owner reviews aggregate access/fallback counts and masks small-cell result receipt values
accessibility_and_protected_support.non_misuse_boundary: coach outputs cannot be used as disability, discipline, ability, motivation, or risk labels

security.prompt_injection_exposure: teacher-entered practice text only; no retrieval or student upload required
security.retrieved_or_uploaded_content_risk: approved curriculum fragments and de-identified attempted-step summaries
security.tool_or_action_misuse_risk: no tools, writes, messages, grades, or records enabled
security.data_exfiltration_check: no learner profile, raw work export, or protected facts in sandbox readout
security.incident_reconstruction_without_surveill: owner records only incident class counts and stop decision
security.safe_degradation_and_manual_fallback: turn off coach and use ordinary teacher/tutor questioning

workload.teacher_review_burden: count planning, in-session review, correction, fallback, readout, owner-review stop, and result-recording minutes separately using the rev0336 field handoff bundle, micro-pilot packet, cycle run sheet, readiness scorecard, next-action brief, scratch-only owner-review record, and chronology-checked suppressed local result receipt
workload.support_staff_burden: none expected unless access/fallback issue appears
workload.security_or_it_burden: sandbox environment check and no-write confirmation

conditions: aggregate readout only with result-receipt small-cell masking
decision.required_human_coverage: teacher or tutor chooses whether to use each suggested move
decision.required_proof_or_audit: local problem statement, locally selected concept, baseline, coach-use and descriptive no-AI transfer rows, move-quality sample, workload and access aggregates, thresholded learner voice, tool/model/version/configuration and prompt-card hash, participation rule, protected local access/equity review decision, owner plan, session log, final readout, bounded owner decision, readiness scorecard, owner-review stop, and descriptive local result receipt through the rev0336 scratch path, including CYCLE-RUN-SHEET.md for exactly one local cycle, ISO session dates ordered baseline <= coach-use <= transfer, owner review after the latest session row, and masked counts/rates below the local threshold
decision.learner_safe_continuity_plan: ordinary teacher/tutor-led practice and non-AI materials continue without penalty

publication_and_adapters.normalization_notes: Realistic synthetic teacher/tutor-facing augmentation example. Rev0332 keeps the scratch field handoff discovery-first, requires local concept selection and intervention identity, adds a generated one-cycle run sheet, labels the first cycle FEASIBILITY_AND_USABILITY_ONLY, masks small-cell local result receipt values, hash-checks generated run-defining files against packet-generation and owner-review records, and keeps readiness, owner review, and result receipts outside accepted evidence, authority, custody, and public-claim support.

public_summary.what_the_service_does: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — NOT A DEPLOYED SERVICE. Helps a teacher or tutor choose probing questions, misconception checks, hint ladders, and reflection prompts during low-stakes practice.
public_summary.what_it_does_not_do: It does not grade, discipline, release final answers, write records, classify learners, or operate as a student companion.
public_summary.required_or_optional: Optional sandbox for participating teachers or tutors; non-AI practice remains available.
public_summary.data_used_high_level: The practice concept, approved vocabulary, and de-identified attempted-step summary entered by the human owner.
public_summary.ai_output_record_effect: No grade, official record, queue, message, or penalty effect.
public_summary.human_contact_or_appeal_route: Ask the classroom teacher or tutoring lead for ordinary non-AI support.
public_summary.accessibility_and_alternative_path: Teacher/tutor-led practice and non-AI materials remain available without penalty.
public_summary.claim_limits: Synthetic example only; not a deployed service or local result. No local evidence yet that the coach improves learning or saves time; the sandbox tests those claims separately.
